title: feat(client): meta.deleteItem names the package whose row it removes, sent as ?package= (#23293)
body:
Fixes #23293
Clause-②: yes (widening): `DeleteMetaItemOptions` gains the optional `packageId`, which both `meta.deleteItem` declarations send as `?package=`.

## What this does

`@objectstack/client`'s `meta.deleteItem` can name the package whose row it removes. `DeleteMetaItemOptions` gains `packageId?: string`, and the one query builder both declarations call (`metaDeleteQuery`, `packages/client/src/index.ts`) appends it as `package=`, beside `state`. The name, the key and the omission rule are the save path's (`SaveMetaItemOptions.packageId` and `metaSaveQuery`): only a non-empty id reaches the wire, and `undefined` and `''` send nothing. Both declarations, the unscoped `ObjectStackClient.meta` and the environment-scoped `client.environment(id).meta`, get it with no per-declaration code, because both already call the one builder.

Why: since PR #23290 (merged as `543b33dee`), the REST reset door refuses a delete that names no package of an item two or more packages hold with `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, and the refusal prescribes `?package=`. Before this change the SDK could not send it. This is the same class as #11391 on `saveItem`.

The option bag's docblock now says the door reads four carriers and the bag declares three. `?dropStorage` is still withheld, under the same ruling as before.

**Level: `minor`** for `@objectstack/client` (`.changeset/23293-client-delete-package.md`). An optional member on an exported request-options type is an additive widening. The house form was checked, not assumed: the two sibling widenings on this same surface shipped as minors. `SaveMetaItemOptions`, the #11391 save-path bag, and the `cf71d73` `DeleteMetaItemOptions` bag are both listed under `17.3.0 ### Minor Changes` in `packages/client/CHANGELOG.md`.

## Premises re-read on `main` (at `614fdec83`, the branch point)

- **The door.** `DELETE /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`) declares `package` in `META_ITEM_RESET_PARAMS`, its accepted query set, and refuses a repeated `package` (`refuseRepeatedQueryParams(..., ['state', 'dropStorage', 'package', ...])`). It reads the value through `metaItemPackageBinding`, which is also the save door's reading (`all`, the empty value and a non-string name no package), and threads it as `packageId` into `deleteMetaItem`. `543b33dee` is an ancestor of the base: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 543b33dee HEAD` exits 0.
- **One builder.** Both declarations called `metaDeleteQuery(options)` and `metaDeleteHeaders(options)`, so the member lands once, in the shared type and the shared builder. Confirmed: the change to those two declarations is docblock text only.
- **Spec.** `DeleteMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId` already exists (it arrived with #23165's change). Nothing changes in `packages/spec` or `packages/rest`.

## Tests (at `13e311f07`, the head this PR opens with: the three commits plus a merge of `origin/main` at `3490bf5fa`)

New cases in `packages/client/src/meta-delete-item-carriers.test.ts`. Each claim is made on both declarations, and each has a negative control.

- **Wire, unscoped and scoped:** a delete naming a package sends `?package=PACKAGE_ID`. A delete naming none (no bag, `{}`, `packageId: ''`, `packageId: undefined`) sends no query string. With `state`, the query is `?state=draft&package=PACKAGE_ID` and `package` appears once; `If-Match` is not disturbed. Encoding matches `saveItem` byte for byte. Both twins put the same query on the wire for the same options.
- **The real reset door** (the file's existing `bootDoor`: real `RestServer` routes, real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, real `sys_metadata` on SQLite). One view is saved into two packages through the SDK. A delete naming no package is refused with `err.code === 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'` and `err.httpStatus === 409`, both rows survive, and the protocol probe shows no `packageId` arrived. With `{ packageId }`, only that package's row is gone and the probe shows the package arrived. The same holds on the scoped twin.

Runs, at `13e311f07` after rebuilding the client's dependency closure (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/client^...' build`) on the merged tree:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 51 passed (51)`, `Tests 663 passed (663)`. The same counts were read at `4ae4bd784`, before the merge.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client run typecheck`: exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists `meta-delete-item-carriers.test.ts`, so the new cases are type-checked.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `13e311f07` derives 63 commands. All 63 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles them as `63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. The four artifact-roster gates whose roster sits under `.changeset/` or `packages/` (`check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`) were also run, and each exits 0.
- Lint, narrowed to the two touched TypeScript files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` reads 2 files with 0 errors and 0 warnings. `--print-config` resolves 6 rules for `index.ts`, so the file is linted and not ignored. The config sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file. The full `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

**Ablation (one-off, no test file kept).** The implementation was committed first. Then `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` removed the builder's `params.set('package', ...)` line from `metaDeleteQuery`: the anchor went from 1 hit to 0, the marker from 0 to 1, and the blob from `3d93926e9ec5` to `209aedd32d88`. The same file then ran **7 failed / 23 passed**. All five wire cases that send a package failed, and so did both real-door cases that name one. The negative controls and the package-less 409 case stayed green, which is the expected direction because they do not depend on the line. The restore was proven on disk: blob equal to HEAD (`3d93926e9ec5`), `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` clean. `index.ts` is imported from source (`./index`), so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

**Not run locally, declared to CI.** `packages/cli` imports `DeleteMetaItemOptions` (`src/commands/meta/delete.ts`) and builds the bag from its flags. The member is additive and optional, and the command reads no member list. The CLI's typecheck lane and its tests need a 25-package build closure that is not built in this container, so CI runs them.

## Acceptance notes

- `os meta delete` (and `os meta register`) has no `--package` flag, so the CLI still cannot name a package on its own commands. The SDK half is what this PR delivers. The command layer is a separate widening in `packages/cli`, and no PR or card in flight carries it.
- The console's reset is objectstack-ai/objectui#12335's half, and objectstack-ai/objectui#12335 remains open.
- The client forwards `packageId` verbatim. How `all` is read is the door's decision (`metaItemPackageBinding`), as on the save path, and this client adds no reading of its own.
